lines.text: When are you going to pick up the boards for the fair?
lines.speaker: Nan

lines.text: I planned to go at five on Saturday.
lines.speaker: Sol

lines.text: The shop closes at four that day. Could we go earlier?
lines.speaker: Nan

lines.text: I can't get there before four. I'm helping my neighbor move.
lines.speaker: Sol

lines.text: How about Sunday morning instead? The shop opens at nine.
lines.speaker: Nan

lines.text: That works. Can we meet by the shop door at nine fifteen?
lines.speaker: Sol

lines.text: Yes, I'll bring my cart to carry the boards.
lines.speaker: Nan

lines.text: Perfect. See you by the door on Sunday.
lines.speaker: Sol
